params.topic: Finland Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 source mapping and API configuration audit
questions: Audit which concrete public source mappings can provide Veikkausliiga official schedule, official_round, meeting_number, venue_by_season, dated pre-kickoff standings, club founded/entry metadata, and row-level fixture identity. Return source name, exact URL or URL template, field locator, language/alias requirements, season coverage, and whether the page is static or dynamic.

Audit the existing Muse source mapping state without treating any old processing, error, unavailable, or request_sha-mismatched response as data. In particular, report that the prior request req-20261003-011 is not valid for ingestion if its response hash does not match its current request, and identify what a fresh valid response must contain.

Audit API-Football as a possible schedule/round/venue cross-check. Return the public competition/league identifier and endpoint/field mapping only if verifiable. If authentication is required or the API key is absent, return status blocked_missing_API_FOOTBALL_KEY and list the exact non-secret configuration needed (environment variable name, endpoint family, requested fields). Never return or ask for an API key, password, bearer token, or credential value.

Separate source mapping facts from actual retrieved fixture facts. Do not claim a field is filled merely because an endpoint exists. Do not infer official_round or meeting_number from date/order. Preserve conflicts and unavailable states with source evidence.

Return two top-level audit targets: muse_response and api_football. For each include status, source URL/config reference, field mapping, retrieved_at, source_sha256 when a document was fetched, and unresolved reasons. Do not return odds, Qimen fields, model direction, probability, Outcome, Review, Gold, or formal predictions.
